newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: First Holdings 2.0 bln peso debt approved.
newsitem.headline: First Holdings 2.0 bln peso debt approved.

text.p: The Philippine Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) said on Monday it had approved the First Philippine Holdings Corp's 2.0 billion peso long-term commercial paper issue.
First Gas, a joint venture between FPHC and British Gas Plc, plans to construct a 990-megawatt power plant in Batangas near Manila.

Rockwell Land, a partnership between FPHC, Benpres Holdings Corp and the Manila Electric Co, plans to develop a residential and commercial centre on a 15.5-hectare property in Manila's Makati business district.
First Philippine Realty, a unit of FPHC, also plans to develop a 300-hectare industrial estate south of Manila.
FPHC also has equity in First Philippine Infrastructure, the firm that plans to rehabilitate and expand the expressways on the Philippines' main island of Luzon.
